description: This file defines a template class 'RecorderType' within the WPEFramework::Core namespace, which implements a recording mechanism for values and timestamps, including nested classes for reading and writing recordings. It includes methods for storing, loading, and navigating measurement data, with support for delta encoding and file management.

classes.name: RecorderType
classes.description: A template class for recording measurement data with delta compression, supporting reading and writing operations, file management, and data navigation.

classes.name: BaseRecorder
classes.description: An internal base class providing core storage and data manipulation functionalities for the recorder.

classes.name: RecorderType::Writer
classes.description: A nested class responsible for recording data points and saving them to files.

classes.name: RecorderType::Reader
classes.description: A nested class responsible for reading recorded data points from files and navigating through them.

methods.name: Store
methods.description: Stores a measurement value with timestamp, updating internal state and delta encoding.

methods.name: StepForward
methods.description: Advances the internal pointer to the next data point, updating timestamp and value based on stored deltas.

methods.name: StepBack
methods.description: Moves the internal pointer to the previous data point, reversing timestamp and value updates.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads measurement data from a file into the recorder, reconstructing the internal state.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Saves the current measurement data to a file.

methods.name: SnapShot
methods.description: Creates a snapshot of the current data state into another recorder instance.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the recorder to a specific measurement ID.
